reviews.text: I am super pleased with the work they did for me at this salon. Lissy was very kind as was her mother. I felt confident from the first moment I arrived. I had a hair and nail treatment with Julianenailmaster. She works super well. She is super charming. I recommend her 100%.♥️

Lissy is the best! I’ve been going to her for years and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my hair. She keeps my hair healthy, and it has grown a-lot since I started coming here. Also, The shop is very clean and comfortable. 5⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Lissy and her mom are such great stylists! I was offered some coffee, received a free deep conditioning, amazing cut and the best blow out you can ever ask for!! I'm a new loyal customer 😀
